executionResult.executionNotes: Implemented page selection and 90/180/270-degree rotation, interactive crop selection with resizable visual handles, rotation-aware crop-box coordinate conversion, and page-transform undo/redo. Updated PDF bytes reload into the viewer and flow through the existing save/autosave serialization. Added component and service regression coverage.
